title: Cactus Jack and Terry Funk turn friendship into war
summary: Two wrestlers associated with extreme punishment battle over pride and loyalty. Their rivalry later changes shape when Cactus sides with Raven against Funk and Dreamer.

chapters.title: Cactus defeats his hardcore rival
chapters.context: The victory does not bring reconciliation between the two veterans.

chapters.title: Funk and Dreamer face Raven’s allies
chapters.result: Funk and Dreamer defeat Raven and Cactus.
chapters.context: Cactus’s new allegiance turns the personal dispute into part of Dreamer’s larger conflict with Raven.
